meta.name: sdxl_txt2img_lora_v1
meta.description: SDXL txt2img + LoRA graph (T-0209, docs/design/13-asset-pipeline.md §6.9) -- CheckpointLoaderSimple -> LoraLoader -> CLIPTextEncode x2 + EmptyLatentImage -> KSampler -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage. Node 12 (LoraLoader) sits between the checkpoint and the model/clip consumers: it takes model+clip from node 4 and passes modified model+clip to node 3 (KSampler) and nodes 6+7 (CLIPTextEncode). VAE is taken directly from the checkpoint (node 4, output 2) and bypasses the LoRA. No init image -- pure txt2img generation with LoRA conditioning. Node IDs are stable; add a new template file for graph-shape changes.
